title: handy
text: handy. This is a simple ring/jewelry holder.  I wanted something that was small... didn't have a lot of things sticking out of it to get caught... just a simple ring holder.  This is it.  It sits on my small desk, next to my laptop.  The bottom portion looks a little under 3" in diameter... the center prong stands up about 3"or so and is tapered - wider at the base than the top.  It is clear glass - which makes it easy to wipe out and clean.  It is exactly what I was looking for and what I expected.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new information seem useful.

details.Manufacturer: Studio Crystal a Division of Studio Silversmiths
